summary: Iter 169 (Phase-1 Solution Box status filter + Phase-2 Decision Template public gating) — Backend 12 passed / 1 skipped (no Completed decider in user's seed data; tested as fixture-skip per design). Frontend: all 6 status chips (status-chip-all/draft/ip_low/ip_mid/ip_high/completed) render under the type chips, tap-filter works correctly (ip_high returned only >70% in-progress cards e.g. 75% & 88%; completed returned 0 cards; All reset returned full set). 'VC pick reorder demo' card pill reads 'In Progress · 75%' as specified. CloneTemplateModal Template tab — visibility-public is visually locked with lock icon and label '· Completed only', tapping it does NOT switch selection (stays on Private); visibility-private and visibility-shared remain selectable; backend POST /decisions/{id}/save-as-template correctly returns 400 for visibility=public on non-completed decider and 200 for visibility=private. ONE CRITICAL BUG fixed by tester: CloneTemplateModal.tsx referenced `isCompleted` 3 times but never declared the variable — would throw ReferenceError on render. Added `const isCompleted = decision?.status === 'completed';` after the useState block. ui_bugs.issue: `isCompleted` was referenced (lines 131, 166, 327) but never declared — caused ReferenceError on modal render. Tester added derivation `const isCompleted = decision?.status === 'completed';` to make the gating functional.

integration_issues.issue: Tapping visibility-public when locked does prevent selection (selection stays Private — gating works), but `Alert.alert(...)` from react-native does not visibly render a dialog on the Expo web preview. On native iOS/Android this should work fine. Consider using a cross-platform alert (window.confirm fallback or react-native-web compatible modal) so web users see the explanation, not silent rejection.

issues: Floating 'A A+ A++ ×' accessibility text-size widget overlaps card action icons (clone/delete) on small mobile viewports (390x844) — pre-existing, not introduced by this iteration, but worth noting since it intercepted Playwright clicks until we scrolled.

critical_code_review_comments: CloneTemplateModal.tsx — `isCompleted` was a free variable. Always run TypeScript strict mode in CI to catch this class of bug at build time (the project compiles in non-strict bundler mode so this slipped through).
routes/solution_box.py is clean — single source of truth for progress band, shared by templates.py public-gating guard. Good DRY.
routes/decisions/templates.py imports `_progress_decider` from solution_box inside the handler (lazy) — fine, but a top-level import would be marginally cleaner.

rca_of_issue: Missing variable declaration: `isCompleted` was referenced at 3 sites in CloneTemplateModal.tsx but never declared. The component would throw `ReferenceError: isCompleted is not defined` when rendered (e.g., in the useEffect re-init at line 131, in the handleSaveTemplate guard at 166, and in the per-option `locked` derivation at 327). Fix: derived from prop with `const isCompleted = decision?.status === 'completed';` placed immediately after the useState block. After fix, modal renders, Public option visually locks with lock icon + '· Completed only' label, and tapping it returns early so selection stays on Private.
